📓 В словарь — три слова!

Перепиши слова в словарик: перевод + что значит + примеры. Это твои слова-друзья на этой неделе!
also
🇷🇺 тоже, ещё и
in addition; you add another thing
I like gymnastics and also swimming. · We also have a cat.
talk
🇷🇺 говорить, разговаривать · a talk — разговор
to say things to someone
My daddy talks a lot. · I talk to my friend every day. · We have a talk.
walk
🇷🇺 ходить, гулять · a walk — прогулка
to go on foot
We walk to the gym. · I walk with my dog. · Let's go for a walk!

🕵️ Where is it?

Посмотри на картинку — скажи, ГДЕ оно! Потом нажми на строку — появится ответ.
🏐🧱Where is the ball? — On the wall!
🛏🐈Where is the grey cat? — Under the bed!
🐈Where is the white cat? — In the box!

📖 Tom and the Ball on the Wall 🏐🧱

Прочитай вслух 2 раза 👅 · потом ответь — да или нет (нажми на строку — появятся ✓ или ✗)
Tom has got a small ball. 🏐 The ball is white and grey.
Tom walks to the gym every day — the gym is his favourite place. 🤸‍♀️
Tom talks about the ball all day — he talks and talks! 🗣
Where is the ball now? 🤔 Look! It is on the wall! 🧱
The wall is tall, but the ball is on it. Also on the wall: a clock! 🕐
«Good boy, Tom!» says his teacher. Tom is happy. 😊
YIs the ball big?
YIs the wall tall?
YIs the clock on the wall?

А теперь — вопросики! 🎤 Подумай и нажми:

Where is the ball? — On the wall!
What colour is the ball? — White and grey!
What is also on the wall? — A clock!
Who talks about the ball all day? — Tom!

✍️ Раскрой скобки — текст! ⭐ 0 / 11

Напиши глагол правильно — прямо в окошке в тексте!
Правила-помощник — памятка 📖
🎵 «it, he, she — глагол с s-кой напиши!»
обычно → +s (likes, talks) · sh, ch, x, o, s → +es (watches, goes) · согласная + y → ies (fly → flies, cry → cries)
I · we · they и множественное число → без s! (I like, we walk, my legs hurt) · ⭐ звёздный глагол: have → has
My friend Tom (have) a small ball. 🏐 He (go) to the gym every day. Tom (talk) a lot — he is a happy boy! 🗣 We (walk) to the gym together. 🚶 His cat (watch) the ball from the chair. The bird (fly) over the wall! 🐦 Tom (want) a tall wall for the ball. 🧱 I (like) Tom's ball — I (play) with it too! The small baby (cry) — he wants the ball! 😢 My legs (hurt) after the gym! 🦵
